name: commit-craft
description: Turns staged changes into well-scoped Conventional Commits messages.

interface.shortDescription: Conventional Commits from your staged diff.
interface.longDescription: Reads the staged diff, splits unrelated changes into separate commits when needed, and writes Conventional Commits messages with an accurate type, scope, and body.
defaultPrompt: Write a commit message for my staged changes.
Split my staged changes into logical commits.
Rewrite this commit message as a Conventional Commit.
